replies.author: @geofftefl
replies.text: As an Australian, I recall the struggles East Timor had in breaking away from Indonesia and the determination their leaders had in achieving independence. The long term benefit of what's obviously still a huge struggle is apparent, but their people can celebrate hope for their future without the burden they endured for so long.
